safetyHeroData.heading: Safety of Members - Terms and Conditions
safetyHeroData.description: At Fizzzbee, your safety is our top priority. We want to ensure that every member can enjoy a secure and respectful environment. To help protect your safety, we ask that you follow these guidelines:

guidelinesData.title: Personal Safety
steps: You are responsible for your own safety when interacting with other members on the platform. Always exercise caution when engaging with others online.
Do not share sensitive personal information, such as home addresses, financial details, or passwords, with anyone you have not met in person.
We recommend meeting in safe, public places if you decide to meet offline. Always inform a trusted friend or family member of your plans.

guidelinesData.title: User Verification
steps: Members are encouraged to provide accurate information during the sign-up process. Fizzzbee may request additional verification to ensure the safety of the platform.
We suggest uploading a verified profile picture to help others feel confident in connecting with you.

guidelinesData.title: Reporting Safety Concerns
steps: If you encounter any suspicious activity, harassment, or behavior that makes you feel unsafe, report it immediately to Fizzzbee’s support team.
We take all safety reports seriously and will investigate them promptly to take appropriate action.

guidelinesData.title: Account Security
steps: Keep your account information confidential. Fizzzbee is not responsible for any losses resulting from sharing your login details with others.
If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, report it to us immediately for security measures to be taken.
